name: stress-ng bsearch
description: Start N workers that binary search a sorted array of 32 bit integers using bsearch. By default, there are 65536 elements in the array. This is a useful method to exercise random access of memory and processor cache. The score is the total bogo operations per second (in real time) based on wall clock run time.

environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
